name: Adolence: City of Sin
Adolence·罪恶之都
Adolence: City of Sin
mods.author: 自然常数也有人用? and the Adolence team
description: The city police and the troops that come to their aid, their cruisers, tanks and helicopters, and the dead they are fighting: bred from nests you can place yourself, and rising again from the police they kill.
都市警力与前来增援的部队、他们的警车、坦克和直升机，以及他们要对付的死者——从你亲手放置的巢穴中繁殖，被它们杀死的警察也会尸变。

The city police and the troops that come to their aid, their cruisers, tanks and helicopters, and the dead they are fighting: bred from nests you can place yourself, and rising again from the police they kill.

name: Attack on Titan: The Rumbling
进击の巨人『地鸣』
Attack on Titan: The Rumbling
mods.author: 辣条QWQ (original by Mirka)
description: The Walls and the Survey Corps on their gear, Marley's army, air fleet and Warriors, the Middle-East Allied Forces, and the Titans: shifters who take their Titan forms, Eldians who become mindless ones, and the Rumbling.
城墙与驾驶立体机动装置的调查兵团，马莱的陆军、空军与战士，中东联合军，以及巨人：能变身的九大巨人继承者、化为无垢巨人的艾尔迪亚人，还有地鸣。

The Walls and the Survey Corps on their gear, Marley's army, air fleet and Warriors, the Middle-East Allied Forces, and the Titans: shifters who take their Titan forms, Eldians who become mindless ones, and the Rumbling.

사이버펑크: 블랙아웃 프로토콜
mods.author: Steel Tide
description: An official near-future arsenal: a complete networked war economy, prism weapons, shield formations, covert raids and autonomous carrier wings. Includes the Blackout operation atlas.
官方近未来军械扩展：完整的网络化战争经济、棱镜武器、护盾阵线、隐秘突袭和自主舰载机联队。包含“断电协议”作战地图集。
공식 근미래 전력 확장: 네트워크 전쟁 경제, 프리즘 무기, 방벽 진형, 은밀한 습격과 자율 함재기 편대. 블랙아웃 작전 지도집 포함.

FG 铁锈联盟
FG Rusted League
mods.author: 空中之主 (art by 有人, 基卡 and SS元首)
description: The whole army redrawn in black and acid green — Grizzly and Prism tanks, Kirov airships, Patriot batteries — and the GF plugin's carriers, dreadnoughts, sky fortresses, a Mirage tank that hides as a tree and a hero tank that ranks itself up.
整套重绘的军队——灰熊、光棱坦克、基洛夫空艇、爱国者导弹——以及 GF 插件的航母、无畏战舰、空中堡垒、会变成树的幻影坦克和能自己升级的英雄坦克。

The whole army redrawn in black and acid green — Grizzly and Prism tanks, Kirov airships, Patriot batteries — and the GF plugin's carriers, dreadnoughts, sky fortresses, a Mirage tank that hides as a tree and a hero tank that ranks itself up.

冥府星舰与战略导弹阵列，新增冥犬舰队：母舰、研究所及五种战舰，配备激光、追踪导弹和闪电爆炸。
Underworld starships and a strategic missile battery, now joined by the Hades Fleet: a mothership, research institute, and five warships with lasers, homing missiles, and lightning blasts.

name: Naval Warfare
Naval Warfare
Naval Warfare
mods.author: Naval Warfare original creators
description: My enemies are many. My equals are none. In the shade of olive trees, they said Italy could never be conquered. In the land of pharaohs and kings, they said Egypt could never be humbled.
我的敌人众多，却无人可与我匹敌。在橄榄树荫下，他们说意大利永远不会被征服。在法老与国王的土地上，他们说埃及永远不会屈服。
나의 적은 많지만 나와 대등한 자는 없다. 올리브 나무 그늘에서 사람들은 이탈리아를 결코 정복할 수 없다고 했다. 파라오와 왕들의 땅에서 사람들은 이집트를 결코 굴복시킬 수 없다고 했다.

Rusted Expansion
铁锈扩展包
Rusted Expansion
mods.author: Steel Tide
description: An official tribute to a certain rusty little RTS a lot of us played on the bus before this one — the one where the money came in dollars and your side was green. Six of its classics, Tank, Heavy Tank, Helicopter, Bomber, Gun Boat and Battle Ship, repainted from memory, with their numbers brought across as near as the counter web allows.
向某款铁锈味十足、许多人上课时偷偷玩过的老牌手机 RTS 致敬的官方模组——就是那个钱按美元算、自己人是绿色的。它的六个经典单位：坦克、重型坦克、直升机、轰炸机、机枪艇、战列舰，凭记忆重新绘制，数值尽量按原样带过来。

An official tribute to a certain rusty little RTS a lot of us played on the bus before this one — the one where the money came in dollars and your side was green. Six of its classics, Tank, Heavy Tank, Helicopter, Bomber, Gun Boat and Battle Ship, repainted from memory, with their numbers brought across as near as the counter web allows.
